sources.label: Patches for use with Morphe: danmaku comments for YouTube and Twitch, Twitch cha
sources.author: Sabopura
patch_list: Claims completed My missions rewards and draws their lotteries in the background, without the reward popup or the lottery animation, and shows a short message with the result.
Opens the web pages that SmartNews shows in its in-app browser in another installed browser instead: as a Custom Tab (the browser's own in-app browser) or in the browser app.
Disables SmartNews ad config, native layouts, and reader ad nodes via stable anchors.
